svg.title: Straw Hat Yo! Greeting
svg.desc: An editable, animated straw-hatted character wearing a blue 05 shirt rests his hand on the ledge, raises it and gently waves, and says Yo! on a white sticker border; the speech bubble is its own sticker and appears only while he speaks. His resting expression has a straight, neutral mouth. The canvas outside the sticker is transparent. Reduced-motion preferences (and renderers without CSS animation) show a still greeting, hand raised.
